_comment: Lean hooks: the full doctrine + routing map live in CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded by Claude Code and covered by the ~1h prompt cache), so they are NOT re-injected on every message. setup.sh generates these hooks and writes CLAUDE.md for you.

hooks.command:
printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"MANDATORY FIRST ACTIONS (every model, before responding): call Skill `caveman` (full mode), `architect`, `test-strategist`, `clean-code`, `fix-validator` (preload), `ship-checklist`, `incident-response`, `retrospective`, then read the MEMORY.md index. Full doctrine + routing map are in CLAUDE.md at the project root (already auto-loaded, prompt-cached) so they are not repeated here. If the model changes mid-session, re-invoke the skills."}}'

printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Every message, every model: DEFAULT TO PAL for each task — bulk read to nemotron, report-writing/explanation/validation to groq, structured extraction to flash (full routing + keep-in-Claude list in CLAUDE.md). Read source via bin/code-skeleton first (then Read only the ranges you need); pipe noisy build/test output through bin/strip-noise. Failover on refusal, never stop."}}'
